acceptance_predicates.description: CI derives coverage from authoritative closed types and inventories and rejects every unmapped public diagnostic producer, cause, warning, and renderer variant.
CI rejects known-cause collapse, context-free target/path errors, placeholder-only failure prose, warnings without consequences, and missing recovery disposition.

An executable matrix covers all public command families and filesystem, configuration, tool/catalog, runtime, provider/network, timeout/cancellation, partial, warning, and directory-preparation cases.
Tests prove the gate fails for uncataloged, overly generic, unactionable, wrong-stream/exit, unsafe-command, secret, and private-path defects.
A documented contributor workflow makes every new public command or diagnostic add typed context, human presentation, remediation, and compatibility tests before CI can pass.

definition_of_done: The complete executable negative/warning journey and controlled-defect suite pass at the exact reviewed head.
The required hosted PR gate and all post-merge workflows pass without weakening coverage, privacy, signing, or supply-chain checks.
A privacy-safe receipt binds the diagnostic inventory, exact candidate, independent review, signed merge, and exact-main evidence.

inputs.description: AR-1766 closed diagnostic causes, context, severity, and producer inventory.
AR-1768 explicit actionable presentation for every catalog entry.

outputs.description: Mechanical and semantic human-diagnostic completeness enforcement in PR and protected-main CI.
Privacy-safe exact-head and exact-main evidence for the complete failure/error/warning matrix.

gates.description: Authoritative coverage and controlled-defect tests fail closed for every missing or degraded diagnostic obligation.
The complete executable error/failure/warning journey passes with meaningful cause-specific output and valid recovery.
Independent review, exact-head checks, signed reviewed-tree merge, and exact-main workflows are terminal green.
